title: Privacy Policy
html:
Privacy Policy

Effective Date: 8 July 2025

At Menu Moments, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting any personal information you share with us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you visit our website.

1. Information We Collect

Personal Information:
We may collect your name and email address if you subscribe to our newsletter, comment on our posts, or contact us directly.

Non-Personal Information:
Like many websites, we collect non-personal information such as browser type, IP address, referring site, and pages visited. This helps us improve our content and user experience.

2. How We Use Your Information

We may use the information we collect to:

  • Send you newsletters or updates if you subscribe.

  • Respond to your questions or comments.

  • Improve our website, content, and user experience.

  • Monitor and analyze site traffic using tools like Google Analytics.

3. Cookies & Tracking Technologies

We use cookies and similar technologies to:

  • Understand how visitors use our website.

  • Remember your preferences for future visits.
    You can disable cookies through your browser settings at any time.

4. Third-Party Links

Menu Moments may contain links to other websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these external sites. Please read their privacy policies separately.

5. Data Security

We take reasonable steps to protect your personal information. However, no method of online transmission or storage is 100% secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

6. Children’s Privacy

Menu Moments does not knowingly collect or store information from children under the age of 13. If you believe we have collected such information, please contact us so we can remove it promptly.

7. Your Consent

By using our website, you consent to our Privacy Policy.

8. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date.

9. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:
📧 menumomentsoutreach@gmail.com
